entries.description: New versions show up in About again, and every change from 1.68.0 and 1.68.1 is in this build

changelog.title: New
items: Connect ListenBrainz in Settings to keep a copy of what you listen to on your own profile
Your full history stays on this phone, and nothing is sent until you connect

changelog.title: Improved
items: The app finds new versions reliably, so updates show up in About
Search tells you when the catalog cannot be reached, with a Try again button
The close button on the info card works
Small buttons are easier to tap, including the info buttons and filter chips
Text in Search and the Now Playing controls no longer gets cut off at larger sizes

changelog.title: Improved
items: Closing the player now lands on one full-width mini-player
Error messages are written in plain words and counts read correctly, such as 1 song

The lyrics editor asks before you drop unsaved changes
